caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of lace with uneven edges, positioned horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The lace design features intricate patterns of interconnected floral motifs, including various sizes of flowers and leaves. The colors in the lace are mainly a pale beige and light brown, with some areas appearing darker or shadowed, emphasizing the texture and depth of the textile. The lace consists of open spaces formed by delicate, net-like threads, intertwined with denser, solid-threaded portions outlining the floral shapes. Thin, black outlines and shading are used to differentiate the layers and textures of the lace. There is a thin, rectangular border surrounding the lace, and a signature reading “Florence Truelson” is visible near the bottom left within the bordered area. The overall composition centers the lace sample within a rectangular frame, leaving broad margins on all sides.
title: Silk Lace
